channels.name: Monolith Wordmark

recipe.ground: Single flat field, warm off-white (#ffffcc) or hard black or saturated red. One ground per screen, no gradients.
recipe.type: One oversized grotesk wordmark that fills most of the viewport width. Tight tracking. One small mono line for meta. Nothing else competes in size.
recipe.accent: No separate accent. Contrast between ink and ground does the work. Red (#ff3300) may act as the ground itself.
recipe.photo: None or one tiny inset image. The wordmark is the hero.
recipe.space: Very low density. Wordmark anchored to one edge. Large empty field around it. Meta pinned to the corners.
recipe.motion: Almost none. Slow fade-in or a single scale-settle of the wordmark. Hover shifts weight or inverts colors.

forbidden: Adding a hero photo behind the wordmark
Using more than one display size on the first screen
Adding gradients or drop shadows to the wordmark
Centering the wordmark with a tagline and CTA stack
Adding a nav bar taller than one line of mono text

channels.name: Swiss Index Grid

recipe.ground: White or warm off-white. Flat. Thin gray hairline rules divide the grid.
recipe.type: Grotesk display for titles. Mono for index numbers, dates, and meta. Two or three sizes in total. Left-aligned on a strict column grid.
recipe.accent: One hard color at most, used for a single marker or hover state. Otherwise gray steps (#cccccc, #999999).
recipe.photo: Small, cropped to the grid cell, no rounded corners. Often absent.
recipe.space: Rows and columns on a visible 12-column grid. Numbered index lists. Consistent gutters. Low density per row, but many rows.
recipe.motion: Row hover reveals or highlights. Quick, linear transitions under 200ms. No parallax.

forbidden: Breaking the column grid for visual effect

channels.name: Dark Editorial

recipe.ground: Near-black (#000000 to #333333). Flat. Gray steps for secondary text (#666666).
recipe.type: Editorial serif for headlines at medium to large size. Mono for meta and captions. Generous leading in body text.
recipe.accent: No saturated accent. Use off-white for emphasis and mid-gray for support.
recipe.photo: Full-bleed or large dark-toned photography with low contrast. Captions in mono.
recipe.space: Low density. Long single-column reading measure. Large vertical rhythm between sections.
recipe.motion: Slow fades on scroll. Image reveals by opacity. Nothing bouncy.

forbidden: Pure white body text on pure black at full weight for long reads

channels.name: Warm Paper Editorial

recipe.ground: Warm cream or paper tone (#ffffcc), with a faint pink or gray secondary (#ffcccc, #cccccc). Flat, no texture overlay.
recipe.type: Editorial serif for headlines and body. Optional mono for small meta. Italic for emphasis.
recipe.accent: Soft muted tint such as pale pink. Use it for a highlight band or a rule, not for text.
recipe.photo: Print-like photography with muted color. Framed with a thin margin and a caption.
recipe.space: Low density. Narrow text column. Wide margins like a printed page.
recipe.motion: Minimal. Gentle fade or underline-draw on links.

forbidden: Heavy drop shadows or glass effects

channels.name: Bold Primary Brutalist

recipe.ground: Hard black field or pure saturated primary (red #ff3300). Two colors at most per screen.
recipe.type: Heavy grotesk display, uppercase or tight, at very large size. Mono for meta. Sharp hierarchy with big size jumps.
recipe.accent: One pure primary (red #ff3300 or yellow #ffff00) against black. High contrast, no tints.
recipe.photo: Rare. If used, high-contrast, cropped hard, with no soft treatment.
recipe.space: Dense or edge-to-edge. Blocks butt against each other. Thick rules. No soft padding.
recipe.motion: Abrupt. Hard cuts, marquee text, instant color inversions on hover.

forbidden: Using more than two colors with black

channels.name: Experimental Type Lab

recipe.ground: Black field with one high-chroma color (yellow #ffff00) and a dark olive secondary (#333300).
recipe.type: Letterforms treated as the main object. Stretch, stack, rotate, or distort a display face. Mono for labels and controls. Type specimens laid out on a grid.
recipe.accent: One acid color for the active glyph or the control state.
recipe.space: Low density. A few large glyphs or specimens on a grid with mono labels at the edges.
recipe.motion: Type responds to the cursor or scroll. Variable font axes animate. Glyphs swap or morph.

forbidden: Using more than one acid accent
Body copy in a display face

recipe.ground: White or light gray. Flat. Gray steps (#cccccc, #999999) for rules and secondary text.
recipe.type: Grotesk display for project titles. Plain sans for body. Mono or small caps for role, year, and tools.
recipe.accent: None, or a single muted tint for links. Gray does most of the work.
recipe.photo: Project images in large, uncropped frames. Consistent aspect ratio. Captions below.
recipe.space: Low density. Title block, then a meta row, then stacked image sections. Clear vertical order.
recipe.motion: Light. Fade-up on scroll. Smooth anchor scroll. No scroll-jacking.

recipe.ground: Saturated pink-to-violet field (#ff66cc, #9966ff, #cc66cc). Soft gradient allowed.
recipe.type: Rounded or friendly grotesk display at medium to large size. Short lines. Little body copy.
recipe.accent: Neighboring hues from the same pink-violet family. No contrasting accent.
recipe.photo: One sculptural 3D object, glossy or soft, as the hero. Rendered, not photographed.
recipe.space: Low density. Object centered or offset with generous empty field. One short headline and one action.
recipe.motion: Object rotates or floats. Cursor tilt. Soft spring easing on hover.
